title: RestoreReport
description:
⟨H3⟩ `heimdall state restore --backup <file>`: attended, typed confirmation. It recovers
identity and configuration and no authority (ADR-0014 §3.6); this is its report (§3.6
"The restore protocol" item 6).

carried_forward.description:
Whether the replaced generation was readable, so its more restrictive states and
later terminal records were carried forward.

ended.description: What the restore ended, quarantined and voided.

ledger_readable.description: Whether the request ledger was readable.

left_behind.description: The earlier generation left behind, whole, under its own name.

remote_effects_pending.description: Remote effects of ending recovered authority, pending until acknowledged.

remote_residue.description: Remote residue the restore cannot remove (opaque references).

ClientId.description:
⟨M06⟩ Revision 6 (ADR-0012 §3.6, §3.7): a paired management client, minted by the
runner at invitation (`cl_<32 hex>`). It names the enrollment line
(`heimdall-mgmt:<cid>`) and the bridge's argv; it is never a credential and never a
request field that sets a caller (ADR-0006 §18).

DecisionId.description: Server-issued decision record ID (ADR-0006 §3.1 attended confirmation).

GenerationOperation.description: What created a store generation (ADR-0014 §3.6 "The operation record").

oneOf.description: The adoption of an earlier build's flat store.

GenerationRecord.description: A store generation's operation record, as `state status` reports it.

backup_sha256.description: The backup it was restored from, by SHA-256, for a restore.

from_generation.description: The generation it replaced, if any.

migrations.description: The schema migrations applied to it, in order (store schema versions).

RestoreEpoch.description:
A restore epoch (ADR-0014 §3.6 "The restore epoch and the replay fence"). Every restore
raises it, durably, before its pointer moves; a store with no restore is at epoch 0, and
every reference minted before revision 7's migration belongs to epoch 0.

StateRestoredPayload.description:
⟨H4, H10⟩ The payload of a `state_restored` event: what the restore ended
(ADR-0014 §3.6's table). Counts and opaque IDs only.

exposure_disabled.description: Exposure and admission state disabled (`exposure_disabled_after_restore`), by kind.

grants_ended.description:
Grants (with their bindings, slots and owned connections) ended, each with a
tombstone.

policies_paused.description: Standing policies paused, with a cutoff at the restore time.

restore_epoch.description: The restore epoch after the restore.
